options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: config_refresh_interval_seconds
options.description: The interval in seconds for refreshing configuration from the Primary node. Valid range is 30-3600 seconds.

options.name: config_retry_interval_seconds
options.description: The interval in seconds for retrying configuration refresh in case of failure. Valid range is 30-3600 seconds.

options.name: heartbeat_refresh_interval_seconds
options.description: The interval in seconds for refreshing the state of all nodes in the cluster. Valid range is 10-300 seconds.

options.name: heartbeat_retry_interval_seconds
options.description: The interval in seconds for retrying state refresh for all nodes in case of failure. Valid range is 10-300 seconds.

options.name: node
options.description: The node domain name for which this API call is intended. When unspecified, the current node is used. This parameter can only be used when clustering is initialized.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests.
